---
title: "What Causes Flight Delays?"
subtitle: "A look at departures from New York City in 2013"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(nycflights13)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Overview

In 2013, **336,776 flights** departed from New York City's three major
airports: JFK, LaGuardia (LGA), and Newark (EWR). This project explores flight delay
patterns across scheduled departure times and overall delay distributions.

> **Key takeaway:** While flight delays can feel random, clear patterns emerge over the course of a day. However, observational data alone shows associations—not direct causes like weather or mechanical issues.

## Departure Time

Each dot below represents one flight with a recorded departure delay. The
horizontal axis is its **scheduled** departure time; the vertical axis is how
many minutes early or late it actually departed. The view is zoomed to delays
between 30 minutes early and 3 hours late to show the primary cluster.

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Each point is a flight; the y-axis is zoomed to show the main cluster."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5.5

flights |>
  filter(!is.na(dep_delay)) |>
  mutate(
    scheduled_hour = sched_dep_time %/% 100 +
      (sched_dep_time %% 100) / 60
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = scheduled_hour, y = dep_delay)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.08, size = 0.35, color = "#176B87") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 3),
    limits = c(0, 24),
    labels = \(x) sprintf("%02d:00", x)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-30, 180)) +
  labs(
    x = "Scheduled departure time",
    y = "Departure delay (minutes)",
    caption = "Flights with missing departure-delay values are omitted."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

### Key Takeaways from the Scatter Plot

- **Early morning flights are most reliable:** Flights scheduled between 5:00 AM and 8:00 AM cluster tightly near zero delay.
- **Delays build throughout the day:** As planes fly multiple legs, earlier delays propagate, creating a taller spread of delays in the afternoon and evening.
- **Many flights depart early:** Negative delay values (below 0) represent flights leaving up to 15–30 minutes ahead of schedule.
- **Extreme delays concentrate late:** Delays exceeding 2 hours become noticeably more frequent after 3:00 PM.

## Delay Distribution

This histogram summarizes flight records into 5-minute bins. The bar heights
show how many flights fell into each delay range, and the red dashed line marks
the 15-minute delay mark.

```{r}
#| label: fig-histogram
#| fig-cap: "Departure-delay counts for 328,521 flights with recorded values."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5

flights |>
  filter(!is.na(dep_delay)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = dep_delay)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#176B87", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 15,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#C4492D",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-30, 180)) +
  labs(
    x = "Departure delay (minutes; early departures are negative)",
    y = "Number of flights",
    caption = "The x-axis is zoomed to −30 to 180 minutes; the dashed line is 15 minutes late."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

### Key Takeaways from the Histogram

- **Strong peak near zero:** The single most common outcome is departing right on time or within 5 minutes of schedule.
- **Most flights leave on time:** Out of **328,521 flights**, **200,089** (about 61%) left on time or early.
- **The 15-minute threshold:** Under FAA standards, flights delayed under 15 minutes are considered on-time. Only **70,774** flights (about 21.5%) were officially delayed.
- **Right-skewed distribution:** Long delays decrease sharply in frequency—delays over 2 hours are relatively rare compared to small delays.

## Interactive Game

Test your intuition! Can you guess whether a flight was delayed based on its departure airport, time, and carrier?

```{=html}
<div class="card p-4 shadow-sm my-3" style="max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 12px; background-color: #fdfdfd;">
  <h4 class="card-title text-center mb-2">✈️ Flight Delay Guesser</h4>
  <p class="text-center text-muted small">An FAA delayed flight is more than 15 minutes late. Can you beat the odds?</p>
  
  <div id="game-card" class="bg-light p-3 rounded mb-3 text-center border">
    <h5 id="flight-info" class="fw-bold mb-1">Loading flight...</h5>
    <p id="flight-details" class="text-secondary mb-0 small"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="d-flex justify-content-center gap-3 mb-3">
    <button id="btn-ontime" class="btn btn-outline-success px-4" onclick="makeGuess(false)">✅ On Time</button>
    <button id="btn-delayed" class="btn btn-outline-danger px-4" onclick="makeGuess(true)">⏰ Delayed</button>
  </div>

  <div id="game-feedback" class="alert d-none text-center" role="alert"></div>

  <div class="d-flex justify-content-around text-center border-top pt-2 mt-2">
    <div><small class="text-muted">Score:</small><br><strong><span id="game-score">0</span> / <span id="game-total">0</span></strong></div>
    <div><small class="text-muted">Streak:</small><br><strong><span id="game-streak">0</span> 🔥</strong></div>
  </div>
  
  <div class="text-center mt-3">
    <button id="btn-next" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm d-none" onclick="nextRound()">Next Flight ➡️</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const flights = [
  { origin: "JFK", carrier: "Delta Air Lines", dest: "Los Angeles (LAX)", time: "06:15 AM", delayed: false, delayMin: -3, fact: "Early morning flights are much less likely to be delayed because planes are already at the gate!" },
  { origin: "EWR", carrier: "United Airlines", dest: "San Francisco (SFO)", time: "07:30 PM", delayed: true, delayMin: 68, fact: "Evening flights often absorb delays accumulated across the national airspace throughout the day." },
  { origin: "LGA", carrier: "American Airlines", dest: "Chicago (ORD)", time: "08:45 AM", delayed: false, delayMin: 4, fact: "Morning departures at LGA frequently stay close to their scheduled timetable." },
  { origin: "JFK", carrier: "JetBlue", dest: "Orlando (MCO)", time: "05:40 PM", delayed: true, delayMin: 42, fact: "Late afternoon flights face congestion as both business and leisure travel peak." },
  { origin: "EWR", carrier: "ExpressJet", dest: "Atlanta (ATL)", time: "09:00 PM", delayed: true, delayMin: 115, fact: "Late night regional flights are especially prone to severe cascading delays." },
  { origin: "LGA", carrier: "Delta Air Lines", dest: "Miami (MIA)", time: "11:00 AM", delayed: false, delayMin: 0, fact: "Mid-morning departures often experience smooth turnarounds." },
  { origin: "JFK", carrier: "Virgin America", dest: "San Francisco (SFO)", time: "03:10 PM", delayed: false, delayMin: 12, fact: "Delayed by 12 minutes—which still counts as on-time under the official 15-minute FAA rule!" },
  { origin: "EWR", carrier: "United Airlines", dest: "Denver (DEN)", time: "04:20 PM", delayed: true, delayMin: 55, fact: "Late afternoon departure banks at Newark frequently encounter runway queue delays." }
];

let currentIdx = 0;
let score = 0;
let total = 0;
let streak = 0;
let answered = false;

function loadFlight() {
  answered = false;
  const f = flights[currentIdx];
  document.getElementById('flight-info').innerText = `${f.origin} ✈️ ${f.dest}`;
  document.getElementById('flight-details').innerText = `Carrier: ${f.carrier} | Scheduled: ${f.time}`;
  const feedback = document.getElementById('game-feedback');
  feedback.className = 'alert d-none text-center';
  document.getElementById('btn-next').classList.add('d-none');
  document.getElementById('btn-ontime').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('btn-delayed').disabled = false;
}

function makeGuess(guessedDelayed) {
  if (answered) return;
  answered = true;
  total++;
  const f = flights[currentIdx];
  const feedback = document.getElementById('game-feedback');
  const correct = (guessedDelayed === f.delayed);

  document.getElementById('btn-ontime').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('btn-delayed').disabled = true;

  if (correct) {
    score++;
    streak++;
    feedback.className = 'alert alert-success text-center py-2';
    feedback.innerHTML = `<strong>Correct! 🎉</strong> Actual departure delay: ${f.delayMin > 0 ? '+' : ''}${f.delayMin} min.<br><span class="small">${f.fact}</span>`;
  } else {
    streak = 0;
    feedback.className = 'alert alert-danger text-center py-2';
    feedback.innerHTML = `<strong>Not quite! ✈️</strong> Actual departure delay: ${f.delayMin > 0 ? '+' : ''}${f.delayMin} min.<br><span class="small">${f.fact}</span>`;
  }
  feedback.classList.remove('d-none');
  document.getElementById('game-score').innerText = score;
  document.getElementById('game-total').innerText = total;
  document.getElementById('game-streak').innerText = streak;
  document.getElementById('btn-next').classList.remove('d-none');
}

function nextRound() {
  currentIdx = (currentIdx + 1) % flights.length;
  loadFlight();
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", loadFlight);
if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
  loadFlight();
}
</script>
```

## About the Data

The data come from the [`nycflights13` R package](https://cran.r-project.org/package=nycflights13).
Each row represents a scheduled flight from JFK, LGA, or EWR in 2013. Missing departure delays generally
correspond to flights that did not depart, so the charts describe flights with
an observed departure—not cancellations.

:::
